description: Na₃LiV₄O₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.63 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent LiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.60 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent LiO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.38 Å. Li is bonded to six O atoms to form LiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.33 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent LiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-61°. There are two shorter (1.68 Å) and two longer (1.83 Å) V-O bond lengths. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and corners with two equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-63°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.83 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Li, and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na and one V atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Li, and one V atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Li, and one V atom.
